ideas.title: LoRA rank versus accuracy and trainable parameters
ideas.description: 在同一个预训练 ViT 和固定小样本分类协议下，比较 LoRA rank=2、8、16，研究增加 rank 是否值得其参数成本；不预设更大的 rank 一定更好。
ideas.research_question: On DTD and Oxford-IIIT Pet using 25% of the training pool, how does LoRA rank 2, 8 or 16 trade classification accuracy against trainable parameter count?
atomic_claims: Increasing LoRA rank may change accuracy and parameter cost; the relationship need not be monotonic.
A lower-rank configuration may offer a better accuracy-cost trade-off.
success_criteria: Compare ranks 2, 8 and 16 with alpha/r=1, identical target modules, dropout and preprocessing.
Use fixed train/validation/test splits, validation-only equal-budget LR selection and seeds 42, 43 and 44.
Report accuracy, macro F1, trainable parameters, training time and uncertainty; retain all rank results.
subproblems: Which vision LoRA papers specify rank, scaling and target modules?
How can a fair rank comparison separate capacity from tuning budget?
Which accuracy-parameter trade-offs should be reported without claiming a universal best rank?

ideas.title: LoRA dropout under scarce labels
ideas.description: 只改变 LoRA 分支 dropout，比较 0 与 0.1 在 10% 训练标签下的表现，以检验轻量正则化是否能缓解过拟合。
ideas.research_question: With 10% of the DTD and Pet training labels, does LoRA branch dropout 0.1 improve generalization over dropout 0 at fixed rank 8?
atomic_claims: LoRA dropout may reduce overfitting under limited labels.
Regularization may also hurt accuracy, so both outcomes must be retained.
success_criteria: Use rank=8, alpha=8 and Q/V targets for both dropout conditions; hold other regularization constant.
Use identical 10% stratified subsets, validation-only LR selection and three fixed seeds.
Report train/validation gap, accuracy, macro F1 and ECE without selecting on test results.
subproblems: How is dropout applied to the LoRA branch rather than the frozen backbone?
Which evidence supports low-data regularization as a question rather than a known improvement?
How should overfitting and test generalization be evaluated separately?

ideas.title: Restricting LoRA to late transformer blocks
ideas.description: 比较只适配 ViT 最后 3 层、最后 6 层和全部 12 层，考察减少适配层数是否能保留大部分准确率。
ideas.research_question: On a 12-block pretrained ViT-B with 25% labels, can LoRA in the last 3 or 6 blocks approach all-block LoRA accuracy on DTD and Pet with fewer trainable parameters?
atomic_claims: Late-block adaptation may be sufficient for some small image datasets.
The cost-accuracy relationship may differ between texture and object classification.
success_criteria: Compare last-3, last-6 and all-12 block scopes at fixed rank=8, alpha=8, dropout=0 and Q/V targets.
Define exact block indices and verify frozen parameters; use the same datasets, subsets and three seeds.
Report per-dataset accuracy differences and parameter counts; treat a 0.02 accuracy margin as a prespecified design choice, not a paper fact.
subproblems: Which evidence motivates layer-selective adaptation?

What evidence is needed before treating reduced block coverage as an acceptable substitute?

ideas.title: Shallow visual prompt length in small-data transfer
ideas.description: 比较 shallow VPT 的 5、10、20 个视觉 prompt token，保持插入位置和骨干冻结规则相同，研究参数量与性能取舍。
ideas.research_question: How do 5, 10 and 20 shallow visual prompt tokens affect 25%-label DTD and Pet classification on the same pretrained ViT?
atomic_claims: Prompt length may affect both classification quality and adaptation cost.
More prompt tokens need not improve small-data transfer.
success_criteria: Use only shallow prompts with a trainable classification head; keep backbone, placement and initialization policy fixed.
Compare lengths 5, 10 and 20 and a linear-probe reference with equal validation-tuning budgets.
Report accuracy, macro F1, trainable parameters and training time over three seeds.

ideas.title: Bottleneck adapter width versus transfer performance
ideas.description: 比较相同插入位置的 bottleneck adapter 宽度 16、32、64，评估小样本下是否需要更宽的适配器。
ideas.research_question: At 25% labels on DTD and Pet, how do adapter bottleneck widths 16, 32 and 64 affect accuracy and parameter cost?
atomic_claims: Narrower adapters may retain useful transfer performance at lower parameter cost.
The appropriate width may depend on the target dataset.
success_criteria: Fix residual insertion after the original block MLP update, activation and zero-up-projection initialization.
Freeze the backbone and train adapters plus head; compare widths 16, 32 and 64 with a linear probe.
Use equal validation budgets and three seeds; report accuracy, macro F1, trainable parameters and runtime.
subproblems: Which papers support residual bottleneck adapter components?

ideas.title: LoRA versus full fine-tuning with 10% labels

atomic_claims: LoRA may approach full fine-tuning accuracy under label scarcity.
A smaller trainable set does not by itself guarantee lower wall time or peak memory.
success_criteria: Compare LoRA, full fine-tuning and linear probing on the same pretrained checkpoint, 10% subsets and three seeds.
Keep method-specific LR search budgets equal and select on validation only.

ideas.research_question: At 25% labels, does rank-8 LoRA improve over linear probing on both DTD texture classification and Oxford-IIIT Pet classification?
atomic_claims: LoRA gains over a frozen-backbone linear probe may vary by target dataset.
Two dataset outcomes should be reported separately rather than hidden in one mean.

Compare LoRA and linear probing with identical backbone, preprocessing, equal LR-selection budgets and three seeds.

ideas.title: Calibration of LoRA and full fine-tuning
ideas.description: 将置信度校准作为主要评价问题，比较 LoRA 与 full fine-tuning 在低标签数据上的 ECE 和 NLL，同时保留准确率用于解释差异。
ideas.research_question: On 25%-label DTD and Pet, how do rank-8 LoRA and full fine-tuning differ in ECE and negative log-likelihood when trained and selected under the same protocol?
atomic_claims: Similar classification accuracy does not imply similar calibration.
Calibration behavior of LoRA versus full fine-tuning must be measured rather than inferred from parameter count.
success_criteria: Prespecify ECE with 15 equal-width bins and stable multiclass NLL from logits; retain logits/labels for independent recomputation.
Compare LoRA and full fine-tuning without adding a post-hoc calibrator; select checkpoints by the same validation criterion.
Report accuracy, macro F1, ECE, NLL and reliability summaries per dataset over three seeds; no test-time hyperparameter fitting.
subproblems: What calibration evidence is present or missing in the retrieved papers?
How should ECE binning, NLL and checkpoint selection be fixed?
What conclusions are justified when calibration and accuracy move in opposite directions?

ideas.title: Dataset-specific versus shared LoRA rank selection
ideas.description: 比较每个数据集单独选择 rank 与在两个数据集上使用同一个 rank 的策略；共享 rank 也只能依据验证集选择，不利用测试结果。
ideas.research_question: At 25% labels on DTD and Pet, is selecting rank from 2, 8 and 16 separately per dataset worthwhile compared with selecting one shared rank using validation results only?
atomic_claims: Dataset-specific rank selection may improve accuracy at a cost in deployment/configuration complexity.
Selection-policy comparisons can be biased unless both reuse the same candidate training runs and exclude test results.
success_criteria: Train the same rank 2/8/16 candidate pool per dataset under equal tuning budgets and three seeds.
Define dataset-specific selection from each validation set and shared selection by mean validation accuracy across both datasets, with smaller-rank tie breaking.
Fix the policy before final test evaluation; report chosen ranks, accuracy, parameter costs and whether any gain warrants separate configurations.
subproblems: What evidence motivates rank sensitivity without presuming per-dataset selection wins?
How can shared and local selection use the same candidate runs and fair budgets?
How should the shared validation objective and ties be defined without test leakage?
